scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install && cd ../bot && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,web,desk -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run start --prefix desktop"
